messages:
Kevin: Quick sync — release train slots this morning. We have 11:00 (API routing) and 11:30 (model-serving). Who's taking 11:30? Need smoke owner + rollback standby.
Maria: I can take 11:30 for model-serving. I'll run the smoke suite and stay in-channel until +15. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll own 11:00 for the API routing change. Plan: run smoke.sh -> small traffic shift -> monitor latency.
Kevin: @Maria confirm migrations are excluded from your deploy; don't want overlap with the infra runway.
Maria: migrations excluded. Using deploy profile "no-migrations". Snippet:
```
deploy.yaml
include_migrations: false
smoke_command: ./ci/smoke/model-smoke-v2.sh
```
Lee: tagging @deploy-bot to reserve 11:30 slot. @Maria please add yourself to the deploy roster.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved: 11:30 (pool: dedicated-gpu). Owner: Maria. Reminder: attach rollback playbook link and set on-call.
Maria: Added runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollback — steps + quick commands are there.
Sam: Quick Q — if smoke fails, do we traffic-knob first or revert the image?
Kevin: Traffic-knob first: route back to stable variant and disable kv-cache changes. If behaviour persists, revert PR + rollback image.
Maria: I'll prep the command:
```
# route back to stable variant
rwctl route set model-serving stable --weight 100
```
Lee: I'll be on standby to run rollback steps at +30 if needed.
Kevin: Final confirmations: smoke owner = Maria; rollback exec = Lee; slots: 11:00 Sam (API), 11:30 Maria (model-serving). Safety ping at 10:45.
Maria: Will post smoke pass/fail and a quick token-cost snapshot after smoke.
Sam: API PRs are green, plan to merge at 10:50 and kick the 11:00 job.
Kevin: Sweet. After each slot, drop a short note in #deploy-log (who/when/result).
Maria: Will do, linking the runbook and logs.
Kevin: Thanks everyone — closing this thread.
